finalText:
**Green. 625 passing, 0 failing.**

Only 3 of 625 cases were red, all in `order totals`. `orderTotal` taxed the pre-discount amount. Its own doc comment said to tax what the customer pays. Most rows had a zero discount or zero tax, so they hid it.

Fix in [pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39) is one line. It now taxes the discounted amount via `applyTax`.

Next: nothing.
